text: nandisuttaṃ [26] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi nandati puttehi puttimā gomiko 1 gohi tatheva nandati upadhīhi narassa nandanā na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhīti . [27] socati puttehi puttimā gomiko 2 gohi tatheva socati upadhīhi narassa socanā na hi so socati yo nirūpadhīti . tatiyaṃ
